identification: About 19 Biggles books by Capt. W.E. Johns: mostly Dean & Son yellow-shield pictorial-board reprints and 1950s-60s Brockhampton/Hodder jacketed copies (Takes Charge, Buries a Hatchet, Goes Alone, Special Air Police), plus a few unjacketed cloth early titles (Baltic, Air Commodore, Hunts Big Game, Delivers the Goods). Sunned cloth copies without jackets are the only ones that might be 1930s-40s printings; Baltic and Air Commodore could be OUP firsts or reprints, unverified from photos. Brockhampton jacket-number copies (46, 52, 67) are 1960s reprints, not firsts. Overall a common-to-modest collector lot, likely tens of dollars to low hundreds.

No Australian resale-house result found for a Biggles quantity lot. eBay sold listings for 'Biggles lot' / 'Biggles in the Baltic 1940' would settle resale best. Valuation: later printings and Dean reprints $3-15 each; unjacketed OUP Baltic/Air Commodore reprints about $25 each, true firsts about $150-350 each if present; Brockhampton jacketed reprints $10-25. Local rooms pay $75-170 for similar boxes.

viewing_check: Copyright page of Biggles in the Baltic and Air Commodore (OUP date; first printings list other titles on the verso, 1940 and 1937), jackets on Buries a Hatchet, Takes Charge, Goes Alone (printing number and any price on flap), and any library stamps or inscriptions. Read the unreadable white-jacketed Dean volume. Check the Hunts Big Game and Delivers the Goods dates (Hodder cloth could be 1930s-40s).
